# CheatCodes.com 2001 recreation

> An independent historical design recreation by Robert DeVore, built with Kujo SSG and SiteKit. Not the original service. Promotions and accounts are demonstrations.

## Pages
- [Homepage](https://cheatcodes.robertdevore.com/): Interactive 2001 website design recreation.
- [Source](https://github.com/robertdevore/cheatcodes-retro): Implementation and build instructions.
